name: Word Counter

description: Calculate characters, words, sentences, and paragraphs in real time.
shortDescription: Analyze and count text metrics instantly.

seo.title: Online Word & Character Counter Tool
seo.description: Free client-side word count utility to measure writing length, letters, and density.
seo.keywords: word counter, word count online, character checker

faq.q: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No, all calculation runs inside your browser using JavaScript. No data leaves your machine.

faq.q: Does it count spaces as characters?
faq.a: Yes, it shows character counts both with and without spaces.
